description: This source file defines the CohortEditor class, which extends OpenmrsPropertyEditor<Cohort>. It provides methods to serialize and deserialize Cohort objects, including retrieval by ID and UUID, for integration with Spring forms.

classes.name: CohortEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for converting between String representations and Cohort objects, handling retrieval by ID or UUID.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a Cohort object using its integer ID via the CohortService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Cohort object using its UUID via the CohortService.
